text.tspan: Source: UC-24 NF1–14, E1; BR62, BR64; §3.1.5 game / course / chapter / lesson / vocabulary / kanji

Proposed function-level design derived from the SRS. Class, method, DTO and parameter names may change during implementation. Business behavior, data and branch conditions follow the cited UC / BR / NS requirements. UI messages are translated; SRS message IDs are retained.

Preconditions: valid session, required role, active Student account. Section 5.2.1 requires JWT authentication for protected requests. Proposed session persistence is supported by Section 3.1.5: game_session stores ongoing and completed sessions.
